summary: This topic explains the process of assigning optional, additional, or vocational subjects to specific students within a class, as these subjects are not automatically applied to all students.
navigation: Assigned Subject (or similar option within class mapping details)
steps: Ensure the subject has been defined as 'Optional' (or Additional/Vocational) in the 'Subject Class Mapping'.
Navigate to the 'Assigned Subject' option (or similar bulk assignment feature) within the class mapping details.
Select the 'Class' for which you want to assign optional subjects.
A list of students in that class will be displayed.
Select the specific students to whom you want to assign the optional subject.
Select the 'Optional Subject' from the list of available optional subjects.
Click 'Add' to assign the subject to the selected students.
business_rules: Subjects mapped as 'General' can be assigned to all students in a class in bulk directly from the subject class mapping screen.
Subjects mapped as 'Optional', 'Additional', or 'Vocational' must be assigned individually or to selected groups of students.
important_notes: This process is specifically for subjects that are not mandatory for all students in a class.
If a subject is 'General', there is usually a separate bulk assignment option to apply it to all students in the class.
